# Kinetic Flow

> Kinetic Flow Limited builds sales, recruitment and customer software for UK businesses. It is a UK company (number 17526373), registered with the ICO (ZC277693), with its software hosted in London. Its full company website is coming soon.

## Products

- [KineticFlow Lite](https://lite.kineticflow.systems/): a leads manager for UK teams who sell by phone, WhatsApp and email. Every lead's calls, chats, emails and follow-ups on one screen, with AI summaries and a UK number from day one. Free for one user.
- [FullRota](https://fullrota.com/): a recruitment CRM for UK staffing agencies in any specialism, with WhatsApp built in. Shift broadcasts, weekly availability checks, compliance chasing and a shared inbox, with no app for candidates to download.
